report.summary: The application exhibits consistent frame spikes averaging around 20-24ms with significant, recurring GC pressure. The consistent memory allocation indicates frequent heap usage, likely due to object instantiation or temporary object creation in hot paths like Update() or frequently triggered events.

bottlenecks.description: Consistent GC allocation spike (112KB - 154KB per frame).
bottlenecks.solution: Use the Unity Profiler to identify specific method calls allocating memory. Implement object pooling for frequently instantiated objects and avoid 'new' keywords or string concatenation in Update() methods.

bottlenecks.description: CPU frame time exceeds 16.6ms target, causing stuttering.
bottlenecks.solution: Review logic for expensive calculations or excessive Raycasts within the frame loop. Offload complex operations to Job System or cache results if possible.
